t: Din mi sheshshaha labo lebet hakkeneset ad "yishtabbach"
s: Din mi sheshshaha labo lebet hakkeneset ad "yishtabbach" ubo b' seipim: tepillat tzibbur hi retzuyah umequbbelet leolam, shenneemar: "kabbir lo yimas", veomer: "pada beshalom napshi miqqerab li ki berabbim hayu immadi". Lepikak mi shebba lebet hakkeneset umatza tzibbur besop pesuqe dezimra — yesh lo ledalleg pesuqe dezimra kede lehitpallel im hatztzibbur, sheppesuqe dezimra gam ken lo nitqenu ella bishbil hattepilla shettihyeh retzuya umequbbelet al yede shemmesadder shibcho shel maqom techilla veachar kak yitpallel, veim ken mutab lehitpallel im hatztzibbur sheaz tepillato mequbbelet vadday. Veketzad medalleg? Im yesh lo shehut liqrot mizmor "tehilla ledavid" — day bemizmor zeh lebarek lepanayv "baruk sheamar" veacharayv "yishtabbach". Veap shettiqqenu lebarek veliqrot mi"tehilla ledavid" ad "kol hanneshama", mikkol maqom kevan sheiqqar hattaqqana lo hayeta ella bishbil mizmor zeh kemo shennitbaer besiman n"a — day lo bemizmor zeh, kede sheyyiqra qeriat shema veyitpallel im hatzibbur. Veim yesh lo shehut yoter — yomar achar "tehilla ledavid" b' mizmorim shel hillulim, shehem: "halelu et Hashem min hashshamayim" umizmor "halelu el beqodsho". Veim en lo shehut lomar shenehem — yomar "halelu el beqodsho" lebaddo. Veim yesh lo shehut yoter — yomar kol Hashem mizmore "haleluyah". Veim yesh lo shehut yoter — yomar gam "vaybarek david" ad "leshem tiparteka" umedalleg ad "yishtabbach". Veim yesh lo shehut yoter — yomar "hodu laHashem qiru" ad "vehu rachum", umedalleg ad "vehu rachum" shellipne "ashre", ki benetayim enam raq pesuqim meluqqatim. Veim kebar hitchilu hatztzibbur yotzer veen lo shehut lomar pesuqe dezimra apillu bedillug — yiqra qeriat shema ubirkoteha im hatztzibbur veyitpallel immahem. Veachar kak, yesh omerim shetztzarik liqrot kol happesuqe dezimra im habberakot shellipnehem uleacharehem. Veyesh omerim sheen tzarik kol iqqar, lepi shello nitqenu ella qodem hattepilla lepikak en lo lebarek kelal lo lipnehem velo leacharehem, ella im rotzeh liqrotam belo beraka yapeh hu oseh, vehalvay sheyyomrem kol hayyom. Uleinyan halaka yesh lo liqrotam achar hattepilla kede lachosh lassebara harishona, abal lo yebarek lo "baruk sheamar" velo "yishtabbach", shessepeq berakot lehaqel. Umikkol maqom yomar kol habberakot shemmechuyyab lebarek babboqer, kemo shennitbaer besiman m"v. Veyesh mi sheomer shello yebarek birkat "elohay neshama", mippene sheyyatza bebirkat mechayyeh hammetim shebbattepilla. Vetob lachosh lidbarayv lekattechilla lebarek otah qodem hattepilla:

Im ba keshehitchilu haqqahal "yishtabbach" — tob sheyyishma "yishtabbach" mehashsheliach tzibbur. Veim ba samuk liqriat shema veyakol lehatchil "yotzer" ulehaggia lehitpallel y"ch im hatztzibbur — yaaseh ken, ap al pi shello yiqra qeriat shema im hatzibbur, ki iqqar haqqepeda hi sheyyitpallel y"ch im hatztzibbur. Vekol zeh bediabad sheabar veshaha labo lebet hakkeneset, abal lekattechilla chayyab kol adam lezarez et atzmo labo lebet hakkeneset, beinyan shello yitztarek ledalleg kelum kede lehitpallel tepillat y"ch im hatztzibbur:
